title: Wrong player encoded (4 cards)
body:
- Urabrask: `APlayerPassesFilter(Opponent, ...)`, but the text checks spells you cast
- Cataclysm: `EachPlayerAction(Opponent, ...)`, but each player sacrifices
- Zodiark, Umbral God: `EachPlayerAction(Opponent, ...)`, but each player sacrifices
- Duel for Dominance: `ControlledByAPlayer(Opponent)`, but the text is "you don't control"
